answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the ripple queue naming the jade that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, every alias costs 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the grove record exposes exactly who is still on probation. That is 26 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
